name: Question 1
problem:
Let $f(x)$ be the $4$-periodic extension of the function $F(x)=8x$ defined on $[-2,2).$ Select the correct options in the reasoning below, showing the derivation of a series converging to the $4$-periodic extension of 

$$
G(x)=4{x}^{2}={\int }_{0}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

from the corresponding Fourier series of $f(x).$The Fourier series of $f(x)$ is given by

$$
8x∼{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{32(-1)^{n+1}}{n\pi }{{field-1}}.
$$
